answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 21386 Country: India Title: is there any book which gives infomation about the devient beliefs of Ahle Hadees & Salafees? Question: As salamualaikum is there any book which gives infomation about the devient beliefs of Ahle Hadees & Salafees? Answer ID: 21386 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 513/513/M=1431) Study the following books: Tajalliyate Safdar (three complete volumes), Mutalae Ghair Muqallidiyat, by Hadhrat Maulana Muhammad Ameen Safdar Okaravi), Tohfae Ahle Hadith and Muhazarah Ilmiya on Radde Ghair Muqallidiyat (published by Maktaba Darul Uloom Deoband). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
